decisions.reason: As a distant diversification from the maritime core, this service is less likely to meet aspiration levels than core-linked offers, and a large established firm would likely redeploy those resources if results remain merely uncertain rather than strategically compelling.

This recruitment offer builds directly on existing crewing capabilities and customer relationships, so even if early results are mixed it is likely to stay above or near aspiration with limited incremental resource strain.

Because it was only launched in April 2024 and fits the firm's training and crewing base, organizational slack and strategic fit make management likely to give it more time before judging it below aspiration.

This service is close to the established offer, aligned with regulation-driven customer demand and the firm's environmental direction, so it is likely to compare favorably with aspirations and be retained.

As an integrated digital add-on to the firm's ship-management software, the dashboard supports the strategic push toward transparency and compliance and is cheap to carry while market feedback accumulates.

The simulation tool is a complementary capability within the same emissions-compliance package, and its strong fit with digital and advisory resources makes continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.
